  <title>published.SDEDBO.Water_ServiceArea_CC_KC</title>
  <abstract>This Data Product serves as the Water Utility Service Provider District Boundary data for Kenton County and Campbell County, KY. This Water Utility Service Provider District Boundary Data Product shows the service area of the Northern Kentucky Water District (NKWD), along with other water utility providers. This Water Utility Service Provider District Boundary Data Product is primarily intended for display, analysis, and mapping for current planning purposes, community development projects, and GIS-related analyses. The Water Utility Service Provider District Boundary Data Product is not intended for property taxation purposes. This Data Product is stored, edited and maintained as polygon geometry. This Water Utility Service Area District Boundary Data Product may change at any time, with or without notice.
